Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 handling qualities for shipboard launch assisted takeoff, not including carrier catapult launch. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of shore-based and shipboard launch assisted takeoff and transition to self-powered or airborne flight to determine the control power, power and engine response, margin to stall speed, needed to maintain control and complete the takeoff and transition between phases of flight, including 2-D performance analysis for pitch-rate control and launch trajectory, and 6- DOF simulations for automatic control and trim settings for controls free launches, and launch system release dynamics, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum assisted launch end or release airspeed to maximum winds, including gusts and turbulence, ship motion effects, ship speed and turn rate, subject to constraints of the assisted launch method minimum and maximum end or release speeds. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation of shore-based and shipboard launch assisted takeoff and transition to self-powered or airborne flight, and 6-DOF simulations for automatic control, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum launch end or release airspeed to maximum winds, including gusts and turbulence, ship motion effects, ship speed and turn rate, subject to constraints of the assisted launch method minimum and maximum end or release speeds. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct shore-based launch assisted takeoffs for nominal and critical combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, shore-based WOD equivalent magnitude and direction conditions from minimum launch end or release airspeed to maximum winds, subject to constraints of the launch method minimum and maximum end/release speeds.
  (3) Flight test: Conduct shipboard launch assisted takeoffs for nominal and critical combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum launch end/release airspeed to maximum winds, multiple levels of ship motion, subject to constraints of the launch method minimum and maximum end or release speeds.
